fixes.explanation: Good try, baker, because Revelation does talk about a harvest elsewhere (Revelation 14:15, 16). But this angel says something different. When the seventh angel begins to sound his trumpet, “…the mystery of God will be fulfilled…” (Revelation 10:7) I'd stick to what he actually says, like I stick to the recipe.

Sealed servants do show up in Revelation, baker (Revelation 7:3, 4). But nobody asks John to count them here. The voice tells him, “Go, take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.” (Revelation 10:8)
